steps.title: Configure plate filling parameters
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 plate‑filling protocol for reverse transcriptase: specify the number of samples (1‑95), set the RT‑mix volume to add (default 4.7 µL unless changed), choose the well‑plate type (BioRad plate from the OT‑2 default library or the custom Greiner 96‑well circular plate), and indicate which side the single‑channel P20 pipette is mounted on; use 4‑in‑1 tube racks loaded with barcode primer mixes and a prepared enzyme mix in the final tube.

substeps.instruction: Set Reagent Volume to Add (default 4.7 µL).
Select Well Plate Type (BioRad or custom Greiner 96‑well).

steps.title: Add RT mix and mix
steps.instruction: Dispense the RT mix from the final tube location into each well of the sample plate (volume as set above, default 4.7 µL) and perform a single mixing motion after dispensing to ensure complete transfer.

steps.title: Add primer and mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 1 µL of the appropriate primer from the tube rack into each well of the plate and execute a single mixing motion after dispense to ensure full transfer of primer.
